tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Start here. Without an integration, explains the ways to add Trickl (own business such as a SaaS, or a multi-seller platform) and how to choose. With one, returns a step-by-step plan for the coding agent: keys, exact API calls, webhook handling, what to store, and how to prove it works with this ser

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search over the Trickl partner docs (platform API, webhooks, embed widget). Returns section ids with snippets; read one with read_doc. Leave query empty for the full table of contents.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Returns one section of the Trickl docs in full (Markdown), by id from search_docs.

tools.name: check_api_key
tools.description: Confirms this connector's test key works and shows its platform, scopes and mode. Run it before the other sandbox tools; if it fails, the message says what the user needs to fix.

tools.name: register_test_provider
tools.description: Registers a seller (provider) under the test key via POST /providers/register and returns providerLinkCode (needed to create goals) and webhookSecret (to verify webhooks). Idempotent on externalCreatorId. webhookUrl must be a public https URL that reaches the user's receiver, e.g. an ngrok or cloudf

tools.name: create_test_goal
tools.description: Creates a goal with POST /goals/create using the test key. No money moves. Returns goalId, paymentUrl (hosted checkout) and clientSecret (embedded checkout). Amounts are integer cents, USD.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Returns a sandbox goal's current state via GET /goals/:goalId: status, amounts saved, buyer, deadline.

tools.name: simulate_goal_event
tools.description: Moves a sandbox goal through its lifecycle instantly; each event sends the real signed webhook to the seller's webhookUrl, exactly as live would. confirm: the buyer signs up and links a bank (goal.deposit_paid if there is a deposit; for subscriptions also goal.subscription_created, plus goal.cycle_p

tools.name: cancel_test_goal
tools.description: Cancels a sandbox goal via POST /goals/:goalId/cancel, as the user's server would when a customer cancels: collected chunks (and a refundable deposit) are refunded in the ledger only, and goal.cancelled is sent.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Shows every webhook Trickl sent for a sandbox goal, newest first, with its payload and the receiver's result. DELIVERED = got a 2xx. FAILED = rejected, retry scheduled at nextRetryAt. EXHAUSTED = gave up. PENDING / DELIVERING = in flight; check again in a few seconds. Use lastStatusCode and lastErro

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "dev" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_api_key · Private data: check_api_key · Public sink: get_started, register_test_provider, create_test_goal, simulate_goal_event, cancel_test_goal, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: check_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_api_key · Private data: check_api_key · Public sink: get_started, register_test_provider, create_test_goal, simulate_goal_event, cancel_test_goal, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: check_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "cancel_test_goal" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Cancels a sandbox goal via POST /goals/:goalId/cancel, as the user's server would when a customer cancels: collected chunks (and a refundable deposit) are refunded in the ledger only, and goal.cancelled is sent." → after: "Cancels a sandbox goal via POST /goals/:goalId/cancel, as the user's server would when a customer cancels: collected chunks (and a refundable deposit) are refunded less Trickl's fee, in the ledger only, and goal.cancelled is sent."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
